prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A high-angle, wide shot of a spacious indoor gymnasium transformed into a modern educational setting. The scene is dominated by two white compact cars parked side by side on a polished red basketball court, each car surrounded by large, curved display screens showing driving simulations or instructional content. A group of young men and boys, all dressed in traditional Saudi attire—white thobes and red-and-white checkered shemaghs—stand in orderly lines, attentively observing the demonstration. A few instructors, also in traditional dress, interact with the students and the equipment, one gesturing towards the cars as if explaining a concept. The background features gym equipment like pool tables and a basketball hoop, subtly blending the academic and recreational atmosphere. The lighting is bright and even, with natural daylight streaming through high windows, creating a clean, inviting ambiance. The color palette is dominated by the warm reds of the floor, the crisp whites of the cars and clothing, and the soft beige of the walls, punctuated by the blue-green of the pool tables and the digital screens. The overall style is documentary and educational, with a clear focus on the interaction between tradition and modern technology, captured with a sense of order and anticipation.
